description: Election Commission - V. P. A. Lasantha elected as Vice Chairman of the Imaduwa Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy for the office of Vice Chairman in a local authority (Imaduwa Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the process of nomination by a political party and the official declaration of the elected individual by the Returning Officer. This content falls squarely under electoral processes at the local government level, making it an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
